meta.descPoolGame: Play 8-ball pool online for free: a 3D table, aim guide, three computer levels or two players on one device. Runs in your browser, nothing to install.

pool-game.name: Pool game
pool-game.blurb: 8-ball on a 3D table, against the computer or a friend.

pool-game.a1: Break the rack, then pot all of your group — solids (1–7) or stripes (9–15) — and finally the black 8. Your group is set by the first ball you pot after the break. Potting the 8 before your group is cleared, or on a foul, loses the game.
pool-game.q2: How do I aim and shoot?
pool-game.a2: Move the mouse over the table, or drag on it with a finger, to aim; the white line shows where the cue ball will hit and the yellow line where the object ball goes. Set the power with the slider or the Up and Down keys, then press Shoot or Space. Left and Right fine-tune the aim (hold Shift for tiny steps).
pool-game.a3: Potting the cue ball, missing every ball, hitting the other group (or the 8 too early) first, and a shot where no ball is potted and none reaches a cushion after the first contact. After a foul the other player has ball in hand and may place the cue ball anywhere.
pool-game.a4: Easy, Normal and Hard try the makeable shots on the table with the same physics you play with; the easier levels look at fewer shots and aim less precisely.
pool-game.a5: Yes. The table, the score and your wins and losses against the computer stay in this browser, so you can come back to a game later.

pool-game.s1b: Press Play, aim at the rack and shoot hard to spread the balls.
pool-game.s2b: Aim with the mouse or a finger, set the power and shoot. Your first pot after the break decides solids or stripes.
pool-game.s3b: Clear your group, then pot the black 8 to win. Avoid fouls: they give your opponent ball in hand.
